activity_summary: At home you left the reckoning as it was written. The fifty shillings and the eight shillings stay unpaid. The twopence stays yours. You did not turn the evening into tomorrow's walk or tomorrow's church.

entities.name: the Princess's gown
entities.context: Mentioned in The page stays unpaid

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Sunday can be Sunday when it is Sunday.
